title: nan
authors: Li D.; Li Q.; Tang L.; Yang S.; Cheng N.; Song J.
key_contribution: Presents an invariant observer-based state estimation scheme fusing RGB-D visual odometry with MEMS IMU for MAV 6DOF pose estimation in indoor GPS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
